nodes.label: Service Image 2: Home Financial Planning Photo
nodes.description: Warm-lit lifestyle photo of a woman at a wooden dining table in a terraced house, writing on printed documents next to a calculator and a laptop showing a spreadsheet with blue bar charts. Bookshelves, plants and a residential street are visible through the windows. It is a service section illustration.

nodes.label: Home Mortgage (KPR) Budget Planning
nodes.rationale: The image puts the service in a calm, everyday setting. A homeowner works through mortgage numbers on her own at home, which makes KPR planning feel approachable instead of institutional.

nodes.label: Warm Residential Lifestyle Photography Style
nodes.rationale: Golden-hour lighting, a lived-in home interior and a terraced-house street view tie the service to the experience of owning a home and suggest trust and comfort.
